title: fix: remap text provider 429 errors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Maps text-provider `429` responses and error envelopes to `502 Bad Gateway`.
- Preserves `upstreamStatus: 429` for diagnostics and server-error alerts.
- Updates focused unit and observability coverage.

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npx vitest run test/text/genericOpenAIClient.test.ts test/error-observability.test.ts`

gist.headline: The gateway reads the room
gist.blurb: Upstream providers can still get crowded, but their 429s now arrive wearing the right label. The hive keeps the original status tucked into its diagnostics notebook.
gist.summary: Text-provider 429 responses and error envelopes are now returned as 502 Bad Gateway errors while preserving `upstreamStatus: 429` for diagnostics and server-error alerts.
gist.impact: Developers receive a consistent gateway-error response for overloaded text providers, while observability retains the original 429 detail for clearer troubleshooting and alerting.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny mailroom operator at a cozy API gateway, relabeling an incoming "429" provider parcel as "502" while filing the original status in a diagnostic ledger. A friendly CRT monitor robot can inspect the labels, with code-plants and flowers showing that the routing system remains healthy and understandable.
